given: no stock record exists for a given SKU at a given physical location
when: the operator files a stock level for that SKU at that location with a quantity
then: a stock record for that (SKU, location) pair exists holding the filed SKU, location, and quantity
architectural_notes: API-layer AC exercised through the JSON filing endpoint on the boundary (app/routes). The boundary validates and delegates to the stock service (app/services), which calls the stock repository (app/repositories) to insert a new row via the ORM; the repository is the only layer touching the DB session. Validation is a cross-cutting concern owned at the boundary; persistence is owned by the repository against the paired Lakebase branch. Verified as a real-DB integration test asserting the persisted (sku, location, quantity).
